description: List the JavaScript code segments from one scan scored as suspicious, above min_risk_score, with location, snippet and risk details; paginated with limit and offset. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

limit.description: Maximum number of results, 1 to 100; omit for the API's default.
limit.title: Limit

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging; 0 starts at the first result.
offset.title: Offset

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

name: get_js_segments_suspicious
title: Get JS Segments Suspicious
